description: Create a product set in a catalog: a group of products chosen by a filter, for catalog ads. The filter uses Snap's rules, e.g. {"AVAILABILITY": {"EQ": "IN_STOCK"}} or {"AND": [{"PRICE_AMOUNT": {"GT": "15.50"}}, {"BRAND": {"IS_ANY": ["a", "b"]}}]}. Each attribute once, one AND/OR, up to 10 rules; ID lists up to 1000, other lists up to 15. At most 50 sets per catalog. Delivers nothing by itself. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token. Use for catalog (dynamic product) ads, after snap_list_catalogs. Not for ordinary ads: use snap_create_creative and snap_create_ad.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

catalog_id.description: Catalog id. Get it from snap_list_catalogs.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name.description: Name to give the new item. Shown in Ads Manager.

name: snap_create_product_set
